title: Status page
subtitle: A public page with the monitors you choose, incident history and maintenance notices.
daysGroup: Last 30 days, one bar per day
noIncidents: No incidents in the last 90 days.

email.confirmBody: One click and you'll get an email when something changes.
email.unsubBody: You'll stop getting emails from this page.
email.invalid: This link is no longer valid.

settings.emptyDesc: Pick the monitors your customers care about and share one link.
settings.addressHint: Letters, digits and dashes. Your page lives at {url}.
settings.publishedHint: Off keeps the page private (it answers 404).
settings.monitorsHint: Only the name and state of these leave your hub. Rename one to hide internal names.
settings.noMonitors: No monitors in this team yet. Add one under Uptime.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete this status page and its maintenance notices?
settings.emailOff: Email updates turn on once mail is set up. RSS works already.
settings.needPermission: Ask a team admin to change the status page.
settings.addressInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
